summary: Wake a free agent seat when a queue move, a new run, or newly ready work changes its first eligible entry. Busy seats are not interrupted; once a held claim ends, the current eligible head is woken. An unchanged head sends no additional queue-head wake.

schema.detail: Uses existing work wake messages and their idempotency keys.

rules.detail: Queue ordering and claim capacity are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Free seats receive an existing work wake for a changed eligible queue head. A seat without free capacity receives no queue-head notice; its held claim, including a claim carried by revision, remains undisturbed. Normal claim waking applies once the seat is free.

recovery.detail: Older daemons retain the previous held-seat wake behavior.
